values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Remote rustic state forest campground on Big Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan), ~10 mi S of Garden via County Road 483 and Portage Bay Road; many sites have Lake Michigan views. Access is ~8-10 mi of dirt/gravel road, the last few miles tight with low branches: reviewers fit ~22-ft RVs, so it is tight for a 23-ft rig and large trailers are not recommended. Ninga Aki Pathway (2.7 mi) hiking; an unimproved boat ramp for very small boats south of the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 23 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual; the table says 22). Boilerplate 'tent and small trailer' wording, silent on length. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation 'no'. DNR page silent on the access road (the note's reviewer caveat about the tight last miles kept). Note trimmed of field restatements.
